item.title: Eyewitness Sports Scoreboard for Friday, February 6
item.description: Three local volleyball teams punched their ticket to the Section III semifinals on Thursday, while several others are looking to join them as the last few teams on the road to Central Valley Academy and the Section III finals! We had several big basketball games across the area on Thursday, and you can catch up with all the latest scores on the Friday Edition of the Eyewitness Sports Scoreboard!

item.title: Syracuse crushes Boston College for ninth ACC win
item.description: CHESTNUT HILL, M.A. (WSYR-TV) - The Syracuse women's basketball team cruised to its 19th win of the season on Thursday night, crushing Boston College on the road 93-59. item.title: Picente appoints new Oneida County Public Defender
item.description: Oneida County Executive Anthony Picente announced today that there will be a new Public Defender serving the county.

item.title: Federal judge allows Gateway Project funding to resume
item.description: A federal judge has granted the New York Attorney General's Office's motion for a temporary restraining order to prohibit the shutdown of the Gateway Tunnel project.

item.title: Increased patrols, sobriety checkpoints for Big Game weekend
item.description: ALBANY, N.Y. (NEWS10) -- Law enforcement across the state is increasing patrols in anticipation of celebrations for the Big Game. item.title: New York mulls moratorium on new data centers
item.description: New York state lawmakers have proposed a bill to pause the construction of new data centers for three years to study the environmental and economic impact of AI technology.

item.title: Syracuse Hancock International Airport to reach new heights with 2026 plans
item.description: The Syracuse Regional Airport Authority is looking ahead to a busy year with plans for a consolidated rental car facility, cargo development, and a new bag system, as well as increased air service and a positive economic impact on the region.
